name: AI Tools Explained
bildvorlage: {einstellung} of {motiv} as the clear focal subject, {aktion}, in {ort}, {epoche}
bildstil_prompt: Realistic hand-painted digital painting, open-world-game key art look: lifelike faces, thin linework only around figures, rich material textures, deep warm contrast, soft depth of field, visible brushwork. Vivid, warm, inviting and richly filled; where fitting lived-in streets, warm haze, buildings true to the scene period and place. Original fictional characters. One clear focal action in the central 60 percent, coherent perspective and plausible period-appropriate props. Natural anatomy, simple readable hand poses, distinct objects. Plain unmarked surfaces.
winkel: the trending AI topic itself - what just happened, what it lets you do now, and an honest limitation
AI that saves you money - what it costs, what the free option already does, and when paying is worth it; prices only from official pricing pages
AI that helps you earn - one honest, concrete way to use it for paid work or a small business; no income promises or invented earnings
AI that saves you time - one concrete task each tool does for you
